name: io.github.data443/vaikora-guard-mcp
title: Vaikora Guard
description: Policy-engine MCP server that evaluates AI agent actions against the Vaikora policy engine before execution. Returns ALLOW, ALLOW_LOG, CONSTRAIN, or BLOCK decisions with SHA-256 audit receipts.

environmentVariables.name: VAIKORA_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Vaikora policy engine (vaikora-llm-gateway HTTP API).

environmentVariables.name: VAIKORA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Vaikora gateway.

environmentVariables.name: VAIKORA_FAIL_CLOSED
environmentVariables.description: Block when the gateway is unreachable. Defaults to true.
